# Contracts errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by Metalama.Patterns.Contracts.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama5001> | A range contract is applied to a declaration whose numeric type can't hold any value of the range. |
| <xref:lama5002> | A `[NotNull]` or `[Required]` contract is applied to a declaration of nullable type. |
| <xref:lama5003> | An explicit `[NotNull]` or `[Required]` contract is redundant because a fabric already adds `[NotNull]`. |
| <xref:lama5004> | The `[SuspendInvariants]` aspect is used without enabling invariant suspension for the type. |
| <xref:lama5005> | A method is marked with `[SuspendInvariants]`, but its declaring type has no invariants. |
| <xref:lama5006> | A range contract is redundant because the type of the target always satisfies the range. |
| <xref:lama5007> | An inequality contract such as `[Positive]` is used without specifying whether the inequality is strict. |
